Undergraduate Students.Medical Entitlement: Entitled to treatment available at IITB Hospital while present on campus.
Undergraduate Students.Graduation: Medical entitlement ceases five days after graduation or the last date of vacating the hostel.

Postgraduate Students.Medical Entitlement: Entitled to treatment available at IITB Hospital while present on campus.
Postgraduate Students.Graduation: Medical entitlement ceases five days after graduation or the last date of vacating the hostel.

PhD Scholars.Duration of Benefits: Maximum of 06 years or till ten days after PhD viva-voce if staying on campus.
PhD Scholars.Family: Spouse and children can avail IITB hospital outpatient facility.

Outstation Medical Benefits.General Rule: No outstation medical treatment is admissible except for accidental treatment.

Reimbursement.Eligibility: Students registered at IITB Hospital with a medical file issued after vaccination verification.
Covered Expenses: Pathology/radiology charges incurred in an empanelled facility.
Indoor treatment on the advice of IIT Bombay Hospital.
Reimbursement.Ceiling: Up to Rs. 2 lakhs per semester.

Accidental Injury.Coverage: Hospitalization in the general ward category, with a maximum reimbursement of 2 lakhs per incident.

Medical Advance.Eligibility: Up to Rs. 1 lakh for in-patient treatment in an empanelled hospital.
Medical Advance.Application Process: Email application to the incharge CMO with IITB Hospital reference and treating hospital's estimate.

Additional Points.Dean's Financial Powers: Dean (SA) can recommend additional reimbursement of INR 5 Lakhs for eligible claims, considered a loan to be settled before obtaining a degree.
